entries.title: Settings on your iPhone and iPad closes with a round X
entries.body: On iOS 26 and later, the top of Settings on your iPhone and iPad now shows two matching round buttons, as Apple's own sheets do: a back arrow on the left and an X on the right that closes Settings. Your choices still save as you make them. On iOS 18 the back button still names the page it returns to, and Done stays a word.

picture.alt: The top of the Appearance page in Settings on an iPhone: a round back arrow on the left, the title Appearance, and a matching round X on the right, above the Theme choice.
